title: Lab 24 — Data Protection with Amazon Macie
description: Use Amazon Macie to discover synthetic personal data in an S3 bucket, read the findings and connect them to the controls that keep PII out of training data and prompts.

steps.title: Step 1: Why PII must never reach training data or prompts
Step 2: Create a bucket and upload synthetic sample data
Step 4: Create a custom data identifier and run a discovery job
Step 5: Read the findings and turn them into data controls
